title: A rational rectangular-chart point Arb-certifiably improves K1749's selected linear section

pre_flight.problem_match: Test whether the rectangular-domain locator produces a rigorous finite-strength improvement beyond the local K1738 linear section at q=1/1024.
pre_flight.rederived_inputs: Recompute K1749's selected section from the isolated cubic and chart Jacobian, then compare it with an exact rational c,z point.
pre_flight.scope: One named q and two named interior channels; no interval Newton or parameter-domain exclusion.

scope_guard: The certificate orders two named channels only. It does not certify the numerical locator, a stationary point, uniqueness, a boundary collar, or a global minimum.

post_flight.strongest_overclaim: A strict rational-point improvement over the local selected jet is not a chart-global optimizer theorem.
post_flight.strongest_counterexample_seam: A different remote interior point or any unresolved boundary collar may still be lower.
post_flight.reproducibility_seam: Replay uses the existing local python-flint 0.9.0 environment, positive-denominator interval Taylor quadrature and analytic Gaussian tails.
